== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ゴールド１</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-141o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットか乗客を２名まで乗せられる。パイロットがいなければ、戦闘力、回避値、航行速度は使えない。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いのゴールド中隊の隊長機。パイロットは、ジョン・“ダッチ”・ヴァンダー。同機はレンフォーラ基地ではスペクター１であった。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Gold 1.

'''Card text:''' May carry up to two pilots or passengers. Without a pilot, its power, maneuver, and hyperspeed cannot be used.

'''Lore:''' Gold Squadron's lead ship at the Battle of Yavin. Its pilot was Jon “Dutch” Vander. At Renforra Base the same ship was Specter 1.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 3

* '''Uniqueness:''' Unique (one marker)
* '''Power:''' 2
* '''Maneuver:''' 3
* '''Hyperspeed:''' 4
* '''Deploy:''' 1
* '''Forfeit:''' 3

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
